name: Moormerland (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of black, red and blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Moormerland (two red towers and a blue boat on white).
history: Municipal flag of Moormerland; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Moormerland arms — towers and boat on white
